scoring_justification: Checker recomputes expected work-function and density profile from the paper's equations; compares pointwise with absolute tolerances, monotonic reward.

outputs.description: Work-function as a function of adsorbate surface density for three adlayer thicknesses.
Normalized electron density profile for clean and covered surfaces.

output_contract.notes: The experimental comparison (Fig. 3) is excluded because the experimental data are not public. The work-function and density profile are computational predictions that can be verified against hidden gold values derived from the same equations with high precision.

hidden_assets.purpose: Hidden tolerances and model parameters for on-the-fly recompute of gold values.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper equations (2), (10), (11) and explicitly reported constants (rs=2.085, κ=16).
hidden_assets.generation_method: Parameters and tolerances derived from the paper; no external file needed.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Tolerances chosen to absorb legitimate root-finding differences while rejecting gross errors.
